graphNotice: Quick node/edge view of the same flow — click any node to edit its parameters directly in the inspector below.
graphEmpty: Add a step in the flow to see the graph.
processModelEmpty: Add a Sequence, XOR, AND, or Rework block to start building your process model.
stampNodeIds: Stamp graph node ids (n1, n2 …) on the model
processModelNotice: Click a box, gateway or loop to edit it right here; click the + on a connector to insert a block at that spot.

dropFilesHere: Drag & drop .xlsx, .xls or .csv file(s) here, or click to browse
dropFilesHint: Supports 1 Excel workbook with nodes & edges sheets, or 2 CSV files (nodes.csv & edges.csv).
importAppliedSuccess: Successfully imported {nodes} nodes, {edges} edges, and {tasks} tasks into project.
nodesRequiredWarn: Please upload a file containing nodes data.
edgesRequiredWarn: Please upload a file containing edges data.

inspector.tip: 👉 **Inspector:** Click any step, gateway, or loop on the diagram to edit it directly (name, duration, probability, add branch, insert steps, etc.).

dragNodeTip: Tip: Drag nodes or arrow handles to customize the layout freely.
exportGraphDescription: Export the graph structure with all tasks, gateways, probabilities, and loops formatted for Excel, CSV, or external analysis.
eventLogDesc: Simulated event log traces generated from the process model, formatted for Process Mining and organizational analysis.
noEventsFound: No events found in the event log. Add blocks to your process model to generate events.
socialNetworkDesc: Visualizes resource interactions, handover of work, and collaboration dynamics derived from the event log.
noInteractions: No interactions found with current filter threshold.
clickNodeHint: Click any node in the diagram to inspect direct handovers.
evaluationDesc: Centrality metrics (Degree, Betweenness, Closeness) of participants based on Process Mining standards.
cardDegreeDesc: Number of direct connections with a person. Total degree = in-edges + out-edges; bidirectional relations count as two edges. Not total handover count.
cardBetweennessDesc: Frequency of appearing on shortest paths between other participants. Normalized value; higher means more prominent intermediary role in the network.
cardClosenessDesc: Higher value means fewer steps to connect. In-closeness measures from others to this participant; out-closeness measures from this participant to others.
uploadLogDesc: Upload an external Excel (.xlsx, .xls), CSV, XES, or JSON event log to verify process compliance.
dropzonePrompt: Drag & drop file here, or click to browse
emptyLogFileError: The uploaded file contains no valid event log records.
uploadFileParseError: Failed to parse uploaded event log file.
discoveredBpmnDesc: Process model automatically discovered from event log execution traces.
discoveringProcess: Discovering process model and laying out BPMN...
appliedDiscoveredModelSuccess: Discovered As-Is process model applied successfully!
skippedActivitiesDesc: Tasks defined in model but skipped in execution
wrongResourceDesc: Executed by role differing from model assignment
unexpectedActivitiesDesc: Activities not defined in designed process model
searchCaseOrViolation: Search by Case ID, activity, or violation...
noCasesMatchingFilter: No cases match the selected filter criteria.
slaEvaluationDesc: Compare actual execution time against standard benchmark duration (SLA) for each task and detect bottlenecks.
searchBenchmarks: Search by task name or ID...
discoveredBpmnLimitationNotice: Discovery scope: currently supports one primary XOR split, sequential prefixes, and simple rework loops. Parallel gateways (AND), nested splits, and complex routing are not yet inferred.
discoveryDesc: Discover process model from event log using Directly-Follows Graph and heuristics.
runDiscoveryHint: Click Run Discovery to build the DFG
noEventsForDiscovery: Add blocks or upload an event log to run discovery.

bpmnImport.loopMultipleExits: A loop has several exits to different steps — they were merged into one exit after the loop.
bpmnImport.tooDeep: The diagram is nested too deeply — part of it was not converted.
bpmnImport.tooComplex: The diagram is too complex to convert completely — part of it was skipped.
bpmnImport.unstructuredCycle: An unstructured cycle was found — it was cut at the repeated step.

calibration.activityNotInLog: "{name}" does not appear in the event log — its time was kept.
calibration.decisionNotReached: Decision "{name}" is never reached in the log — its probabilities were kept.
calibration.loopNotReached: Loop "{name}" is never entered in the log — its repeat probability was kept.
calibration.parallelApproximated: Parallel blocks were replayed in branch order — their probabilities are approximate.
calibration.title: Calibrate model from event log
calibration.description: Task times, decision probabilities and loop rates measured on the uploaded log ({count} events). Applying can be undone.
calibration.noLog: Upload an event log first (Event Log tab).

bpr.title: Long waiting time before: {name}
bpr.description: Cases wait a long time before this activity starts; it accounts for {share}% of all waiting time in the log.
bpr.evidence: Wait median {median} h · p95 {p95} h · max {max} h · {share}% of total waiting

performance.title: Performance & waiting time
performance.subtitle: Processing, waiting and cycle time measured on the uploaded event log. Waiting = gap between the previous step finishing and this step starting.
performance.empty: Performance analysis needs a real event log with start and end timestamps. Upload one in the Event Log tab.
performance.noCasesInRange: No case starts in the selected date range.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: Top 3 bottlenecks by share of total waiting time are highlighted.

chart.title: Where does the waiting time go?
chart.description: Share of total waiting time per activity (waiting before it starts).

calendar.title: Work calendar
calendar.description: Only time inside these blocks on working days is counted when "Working hours" is on (local time).

heatmap.title: Waiting heatmap
heatmap.description: Mean waiting time before the selected activity, by the weekday and hour the wait began (local time).

embedding.title: Graph embedding
embedding.subtitle: Node2Vec on the process graph and handover network, Graph2Vec / WL kernel anomaly detection on event-log traces, and WL-kernel model comparison. Heavy computations run in the background.

node2vec.settingsDescription: Biased random walks (p = return, q = in-out) + skip-gram. Same seed ⇒ same result.
node2vec.scatterDescription: Colour = k-means cluster. Click a node to list its most similar nodes.

anomaly.needsLog: Upload an event log (Event Log tab) to detect anomalous cases.
anomaly.settingsDescription: Each case becomes a START → events → END graph; cases far from their k nearest neighbours in embedding space are anomalous.
anomaly.groundTruthInvalid: Could not read the ground-truth CSV (expected columns case_id, anomaly_types).
anomaly.compareTitle: AUC by anomaly type and label mode
anomaly.compareDescription: Structure only vs + waiting level (SLOW/OK) vs + attribute "{attribute}". Best mode per row in bold.
anomaly.compareNeedsGroundTruth: Load a ground-truth CSV to see the AUC comparison.
anomaly.scatterDescriptionGt: Red = cases labelled anomalous in the ground truth.
anomaly.scatterDescriptionTop: Red = top {count} cases by anomaly score.
anomaly.casesDescription: Higher score = further from similar cases.

compare.title: Compare process models (WL kernel)
compare.description: Compare the current model (AS-IS) with another project or an uploaded .bpmn (TO-BE).
compare.bpmnFailed: Could not import the BPMN file: {message}
compare.iterationHint: Iteration 0 compares step names only; higher iterations also compare each step's neighbourhood.
